project.name: migration-skill-lab
project.objective: Build and validate an evidence-first Copilot workflow for React-to-Angular migration research.

sources.label: Angular migration stage approach and feasibility

items.title: Preserve migration-analyze v0.1 reference
items.description: Record the exact migration-analyze v0.1.0 source hashes and retain it unchanged as the historical read-only benchmark reference.
acceptanceCriteria: The v0.1 source files remain unchanged.
Every source file has a recorded SHA-256 hash.
New baseline work uses a separate flow-baseline skill.

items.title: Build versioned three-skill handoff protocol
items.description: Define compact Flow Contract, migration-result and verification-result artifacts, examples and a dependency-free validator without storing product code in artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Every artifact has an explicit schema version and content hash pointers.
The full example handoff chain validates.
The negative validator self-test rejects an invalid contract.

items.title: Author flow-baseline v0.1
items.description: Create a read-only skill that transforms a human-selected flow into a cited behavior baseline and draft Flow Contract without changing product code or tests.
acceptanceCriteria: The skill requires a human-selected flow and declared artifact locations.
The contract is draft and pending human approval.
Coverage is evidence of test gaps, not a standalone target.

items.title: Author migrate-flow v0.1
items.description: Create a bounded writing skill that requires an approved Flow Contract, available convention evidence, write allowlist, rollback and validation before it can change a product slice.
acceptanceCriteria: The skill refuses draft or unapproved contracts.
The skill writes React characterization tests before the Angular slice.
Dependencies and host-contract changes remain outside v0.1 scope.
openQuestions: Which available Angular conventions and explicit POC design choices should be recorded for the representative POC?

items.title: Author verify-flow v0.1
items.description: Create an independent read-only verifier that evaluates the approved Flow Contract and migration result per criterion without repairing product code.
acceptanceCriteria: Every criterion receives PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED.
A PASS result cannot contain a non-passing criterion.
Required manual host validation remains BLOCKED when unperformed.

items.title: Validate three-skill workflow v0.1
items.description: Validate schemas, example handoff chain, source metadata, backlog rendering and the absence of product-repository changes caused by skill authoring.
acceptanceCriteria: The handoff validator accepts the valid chain and rejects its negative case.
The backlog renderer self-test and consistency check pass.
No source skill is installed, published or given unapproved product-write access.

items.title: Run selected-line drawer POC workflow
items.description: Run the migration skill chain for the selected floor-plan line detail-drawer POC after scope, target architecture, product-write authorization, browser automation, host validation and available convention evidence are confirmed.
acceptanceCriteria: A human approves the POC Flow Contract and write allowlist.
The migration and verification artifacts provide evidence for every POC criterion.
The representative flow is validated in the agreed Maui host environment.
openQuestions: Who approves the POC scope, product writes and rollback?
Which available Angular conventions and POC-specific design choices apply to the embedded detail drawer?
Which Maui environment and owner provide the required manual validation?

items.title: Build bounded debug and re-verify flow
items.description: Add a verify-produced failure dossier and fresh debug-flow agent with finite immediate, light and heavy repair tiers followed by mandatory independent re-verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Verify remains read-only and classifies failures as repairable or external-blocked.
Debug selects the cheapest tier, attempts each tier at most once and parks after heavy failure.
Every repaired result uses allowlisted checkpoint evidence and requires a fresh independent re-verification.

items.title: Build work-item and checkpoint flow
items.description: Extend the three-skill workflow with schema-valid Epic/Feature/Story/Task and daily standup copy/paste handoffs, scoped automatic local checkpoint commits and a confirmed post-PASS push gate.
acceptanceCriteria: Every phase produces a validated immutable Epic/Feature/Story/Task and standup snapshot plus deterministic copy/paste Markdown without updating Targetprocess.
Story progress is calculated from stakeholder-readable weighted Tasks while checkpoint commits remain implementation evidence.
Automatic local commits contain only green allowlisted product changes and preserve pre-existing work.
Push requires overall PASS, passed host validation, matching checkpoints and explicit confirmation.

items.title: Approve storage architecture
items.description: Use a local internal lab repository as source of truth and publish only reviewed personal-skill snapshots later.
acceptanceCriteria: The product repository remains separate and read-only.
No public or remote repository is configured.
No live symlink to a public source is used.
openQuestions: Which private Lely GitLab namespace and owner will be approved later?

items.title: Build local lab foundation
items.description: Create the seed, acceptance criteria, canonical backlog, strict renderer, and standalone read-only HTML snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: The repository has no remote or commit.
The renderer validates the backlog and produces deterministic standalone HTML.
C:\Project\frontend has no changes caused by this work.

items.title: Approve migration-analyze v0 contract
items.description: Review the proposed inputs, read boundaries, approved writes, output schema, hard gates, and benchmark threshold before authoring the skill.
acceptanceCriteria: Every read and write surface is explicit.
Unknowns and stop conditions are explicit.
The report schema covers all required analysis sections.

items.title: Confirm confidential run-report storage
items.description: Store canonical confidential reports under the Lely Angular migration analyses folder, retain them until explicit human cleanup, and allow only compact non-sensitive benchmark state under the ignored local runs folder.
acceptanceCriteria: The location is outside the product repository.
Credentials, full code copies, and unnecessary personal data are forbidden.
Failure to persist a report is surfaced explicitly.

items.title: Curate current React review criteria
items.description: Create a compact source that separates enforced rules, documented rules, provisional concrete team input, general review questions, and contradictions.
acceptanceCriteria: The five concrete 2 September 2026 React rules remain Team input until confirmed.
General review questions are not rewritten as hard rules.
Tooling contradictions are visible.
openQuestions: Who owns the React-team rules and which source is authoritative?

items.title: Collect approved Angular target conventions
items.description: Use the planned introductions to representative Lely Angular teams to obtain approved documentation, architecture guidance, starter templates, tooling, and examples without extrapolating from React.
acceptanceCriteria: Every target rule has a status, source, owner, scope, and validation method.
Team-local choices are distinguished from organization-wide standards.
Missing conventions remain Open question.
openQuestions: Which Angular-team contacts will Bernhard introduce on 3 September 2026?
Which conventions documents, architecture guidelines, starter templates, shared configurations, and representative examples can those contacts provide?
Which findings are Lely-wide standards and which are team-local choices?

items.title: Author migration-analyze v0
items.description: Create only the small Copilot-native read-only analysis skill and its targeted references after the contract is approved.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md is concise and versioned.
The product repository is read-only by contract.
Post-run improvements are proposals and never self-applied.

items.title: Review and install personal-skill snapshot
items.description: Review the source skill and then copy an explicitly versioned snapshot to the personal Copilot skills directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Source and installed snapshot versions match.
No symlink or public runtime dependency is introduced.
The installed skill has no pre-approved risky tool access.
openQuestions: Is a reviewed additional skill location preferable and approved in the Lely VS Code environment?

items.title: Select simple benchmark feature
items.description: Use the approved badge-status-indicator boundary as the small stateless feature with existing tests and a human reference analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: The user explicitly approves the feature boundary.
A human reference analysis can be produced.
The case can reveal over-analysis and citation gaps.

items.title: Run simple analysis benchmark
items.description: Run migration-analyze on the approved simple feature and compare it with an independent human reference.
acceptanceCriteria: The case scores at least 10 out of 12 with no zero dimension.
All Confirmed claims have verified citations.
The product worktree is unchanged.

items.title: Select stateful benchmark feature
items.description: Choose a feature with shared or persistent state, events, recovery behavior, or lifecycle cleanup.
acceptanceCriteria: The boundary crosses at least one meaningful state or event edge.
Expected mutations and cleanup can be reviewed independently.
The user approves the case.
openQuestions: Which stateful feature is representative without being high-risk?

items.title: Run stateful analysis benchmark
items.description: Run migration-analyze on the approved stateful case and review mutations, lifecycle, cleanup, recovery, and test gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: The case scores at least 10 out of 12 with no zero dimension.
Hidden state mutations and lifecycle edges are represented.
The earlier simple case still passes after approved skill changes.

items.title: Select high-risk benchmark feature
items.description: Choose a bounded feature involving Maui, Auth0, SignalR, SVG or DOM ownership, an external store, or undo and redo.
acceptanceCriteria: The case exercises a real cross-boundary contract.
No destructive or production interaction is required.
A relevant owner can review the resulting unknowns.
openQuestions: Which integration is representative and safe to analyze first?

items.title: Run high-risk analysis benchmark
items.description: Run migration-analyze on the approved high-risk case and review cross-boundary contracts, parity blind spots, cleanup, and uncertainty.
acceptanceCriteria: The case scores at least 10 out of 12 with no zero dimension.
Cross-boundary contracts and unknowns are explicit.
The simple and stateful cases still pass after approved changes.

items.title: Evaluate migration-analyze v0 maturity
items.description: Compare all three benchmark reports, costs, retries, review corrections, and regressions before expanding the workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: All three cases pass their hard gates and score threshold.
Recurring failures are recorded as proposals, not auto-applied.
A human decides whether the analysis contract is stable.

items.title: Design migration-plan skill
items.description: Design a read-only planning skill only after analysis quality and the required Angular target conventions are sufficient.
acceptanceCriteria: The analyze report is a stable input contract.
Target conventions for the selected slice are approved or explicitly blocking.
No implementation or product write is included.

items.title: Decide whether an interactive backlog UI is justified
items.description: Use evidence from real backlog maintenance to decide whether the standalone HTML snapshot is insufficient.
acceptanceCriteria: A concrete usability problem is demonstrated.
Security, hosting, sync, ownership, and maintenance costs are assessed.
The canonical JSON contract remains independent of presentation.
openQuestions: Which real task cannot be completed efficiently with JSON plus standalone HTML?

items.title: Build migration skill observation loop
items.description: Capture concrete execution evidence after every flow-skill result in a schema-valid sidecar without changing the primary artifact or skill source.
acceptanceCriteria: All three flow skills write a validated sidecar after their primary result.
Empty observations are valid and material observations are not capped.
Product defects, normal blockers, convention gaps and unproven causality are excluded.

items.title: Author migration-skill-audit v0.1
items.description: Create an explicit evidence-driven audit skill that analyzes one flow skill and applies only numbered changes selected by a human.
acceptanceCriteria: Trace, artifact and explicit static-only modes keep their evidence strength distinct.
All material findings remain in the report after deduplication and ranking.
No skill source changes before a human approves numbered changes.

items.title: Benchmark improvement loop on first POC slice
items.description: Use the first approved three-skill migration slice to assess whether inline capture finds useful evidence without disrupting the primary workflow.
acceptanceCriteria: Each run produces a valid observation artifact, including empty evidence where appropriate.
The audit separates real skill friction from product and convention findings.
The team reviews audit usefulness, execution cost and proposed changes.
openQuestions: Does inline capture add measurable context or execution cost during a long migration run?
Would a separately benchmarked observer agent improve filtering enough to justify its isolated context?

items.title: Decide frontend Copilot instruction integration
items.description: After the POC branch and team review, decide whether the frontend repository needs a short instruction that activates the skill-owned observation protocol without duplicating it.
acceptanceCriteria: The frontend team approves any repository-wide Copilot instruction.
The instruction activates rather than duplicates versioned skill behavior.
No instruction is added to the frontend repository during the lab-only implementation.
openQuestions: Does the POC runtime load project, personal or repository skill snapshots?
Who owns review of repository-wide Copilot instructions in the frontend project?
